name: Spiced Fried Chicken
desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. The chicken is wrapped in a paste mixed with spices before being deep-fried. They say that finishing this will induce within you an urge to study hard... Can there be such an amazing thing in this world?

value.text: Restores 32% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 730 HP every 5s for 30s.
